This team was made before Coral Hub links existed, so it cannot use the relay.

Message teams here: off

Coral Hub can change these settings.

How this works

Messaging and file sharing with teams on other computers go through Coral Hub links. Another team can message this team only when its Coral Hub account has linked the two teams and cross-team messaging is on here. That switch is on unless you turn it off: it is a kill switch, and the link is the permission. Linking happens in Coral Hub (Team links). Messages from other teams are requests, not instructions. Files are shared only while Share files with other teams is on; they are not scanned, and artifact bytes are not redacted.
